title: The Greenhorn's Chance
text: A small beast, hurt and cornered, snarls in a hollow, all teeth and fear. Its leg is broken. The party's least blooded could finish it, and learn something about the work that no training yard can teach.

options.label: The least blooded finishes it, and learns what killing truly is.

outcomes.text: It is quick and ugly. They will remember its eyes for a long time.

options.label: The wisest binds its leg and lets it go, sparing one small life.

outcomes.text: It limps off into the trees. Something in the wood is grateful.

options.label: Leave it in its hollow. It is not worth the trouble either way.

outcomes.text: It watches you go. Later it follows, healed enough to be angry.
It watches you go. The Leader knows they should have let it be finished, and that sits badly.

options.label: The Soldier shows the least blooded how, so it is done quick and clean.

outcomes.text: It is done quickly and cleanly, a lesson learned from someone who knows.
